drafts.title: Choosing Between Qwen3-32b and Qwen3-235b-a22b for Hypothetical Multilingual NER and SQL Tasks: How to Weigh Benchmark Trade-offs?
drafts.body: I'm hypothetically evaluating Qwen3 models for a project requiring strong multilingual Named Entity Recognition (NER) and SQL query generation. The benchmark data shows that Qwen3-32b scores highest in Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) at 92.5 and matches Qwen3-235b-a22b in SQL generation with a perfect 100 score. Meanwhile, Qwen3-235b-a22b also achieves 100 in SQL but has slightly lower NER performance. Both models exhibit limitations with non-English languages—especially Nordic languages in NER and a tendency to respond in English rather than the source language in RAG. Given these points, how should I interpret the trade-offs? Specifically, how might the multilingual limitations affect a hypothetical use case focused on European languages, and is the higher RAG score of Qwen3-32b worth prioritizing over the slight SQL edge of Qwen3-235b-a22b? Any insights on balancing these factors would be appreciated for this controlled hypothetical evaluation.
